text.en:
- This Act shall be known as the "Philippine Dental Hygienist Law" .
Examining Board for Dental Hygienists
Board of Dental Examiners. - The Board of Dental Examiners created under Republic Act Numbered Four hundred and seventeen, as amended, shall be the examining and licensing board of dental hygienists.
